mapper.select: select CONCAT(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), a.shipment_date, 23), ' - ', a.seq ) AS shipmentDateSeq ,a.shipment_id ,a.shipment_date ,a.seq ,a.shipment_req_date ,a.shipment_time ,a.customer_cd ,b.client_name ,a.delivery_location ,a.delivery_address ,a.delivery_manager_name ,a.delivery_telno ,a.shipment_type ,a.shipment_yn ,a.managed_item ,a.attach_file_id ,a.etc ,a.print_yn ,a.shipment_status ,c.lotCnt from tb_shipment_mst a left join tb_client_mst b on b.customer_cd = a.customer_cd left join ( select COUNT(lot_no) as lotCnt ,shipment_id from tb_shipment_item where item_type_cd not in ('M1','M2','M7') group by shipment_id ) c on c.shipment_Id = a.shipment_Id where a.shipment_id = #{shipmentId}

select a.item_cd ,a.po_no ,a.lot_No ,a.make_no ,a.qc_status ,a.qty ,a.stock_qty ,a.pallet ,a.test_no ,a.storage_cd ,b.item_name ,a.shipment_item_id ,a.shipment_id ,a.item_type_cd ,'' as etc ,t.pass_state as qc_status from tb_shipment_item a join tb_item_mst b on b.item_cd = a.item_cd join tb_item_test_no t on t.test_no = a.test_no where shipment_id = #{shipmentId} ORDER BY a.shipment_item_id

with shipment_qty as ( select b.po_no ,b.test_no ,sum(isnull(b.qty, 0)) as qty from tb_shipment_mst a join tb_shipment_item b on a.shipment_id = b.shipment_id where a.shipment_yn ='N' group by b.po_no, b.test_no ), stock_qty as ( select s.item_cd ,s.test_no ,sum(s.qty) as qty ,s.storage_cd FROM dbo.fn_get_stock( CAST(null AS DATE) ,NULL ,NULL ,'M0' ,#{itemCd} ,#{itemName} ,'TEST' ,NULL ) s group by s.item_cd ,s.test_no ,s.storage_cd ) select b.po_no ,'M0' as item_type_cd ,a.item_cd ,i.item_name ,b.lot_no ,b.make_no ,a.test_no ,ISNULL(s.qty, 0) as stock_qty ,ISNULL(s.qty, 0) - ISNULL(q.qty, 0 ) as qty ,dbo.getStorageName(s.storage_cd) as storage_name ,t.pass_state as qcStatus ,a.work_batch_id ,a.work_proc_id from TB_WORK_ORDER_PROC a join TB_WORK_ORDER_BATCH b on b.work_batch_id = a.work_batch_id join TB_WORK_ORDER_MST m on a.work_order_id = m.work_order_id join tb_item_mst i on i.item_cd = a.item_cd join tb_item_test_no t on t.test_no = a.test_no left join shipment_qty q on q.test_no = a.test_no left join stock_qty s on s.item_cd = a.item_cd and s.test_no = a.test_no where a.proc_cd = 'PRC005' and a.proc_status = '52'
and m.customer_cd = #{customerCd}
and a.po_no like '%' + #{poNo} + '%'
and c.item_cd like '%' + #{itemCd} + '%'
and c.item_name like '%' + dbo.fn_LikeEscape(#{itemName}) + '%'
mapper.update: update tb_shipment_mst set print_yn ='Y' where shipment_id = #{shipmentId}
